name: ailib.ru

sources.title: ailib.ru homepage — Russian AI-tools catalog (3,000+ tools), 'Добавить AI' nav link
Add a neural network — plan picker showing 'Стандарт / Бесплатно / Обычное размещение' (Standard / Free / Regular placement)
Free placement form — E-mail, name, site link, description, application sphere (multi-select), task (multi-select)
Advertising page — paid placement contact pr@ailib.ru / t.me/fozzepe

requirements: Product must be an AI / neural-network tool (site is a catalog of нейросети)
Tool must have a public website URL
Form is in Russian; English version of the site exists at ailib.ru/en/ (add-ai page has an /en/ equivalent)
preparation: Russian-language description of the tool (site is RU-first; prepare a translation)
Pick application sphere(s) from a fixed list — multi-select via Ctrl (Дизайн, Бизнес, Реклама и SMM, Разработка, SEO, Музыка, Образование, etc.)
Pick task(s) the tool performs from a long fixed list — also Ctrl multi-select
workflow: Fill E-mail, tool name, site link, description
Select one or more application spheres and tasks (hold Ctrl to multi-select)
Submit and wait for manual catalog inclusion
watchFor: No account system — the free form is a plain contact-style form, so there is no dashboard to edit the listing later
Paid promotion/placement is handled only via e-mail (pr@ailib.ru) or Telegram (t.me/fozzepe) — no self-serve checkout
Sphere and task lists are very long fixed taxonomies; choosing vague categories may hurt placement
Review turnaround time is not stated anywhere public
countsAsLive: Tool appears in the public catalog at ailib.ru/ai/ with its own detail page and is findable via site search
unknowns: Whether paid tiers beyond 'Стандарт' exist on /add-ai/ — only the free plan rendered on the public page
Review time and rejection criteria are not published
Whether a reciprocal backlink is required for the free listing
